en.headline: KMB to open three routes to Huanggang Port on Monday
en.dek: Services from Kwai Fong, Tin Shui Wai and Sha Tin start when the rebuilt port opens, with an interchange concession on more than 100 routes.
body: Kowloon Motor Bus said on Friday it will open three routes to the rebuilt Huanggang Port on Monday, the day the control point begins round-the-clock operation.

The routes are B10 between Kwai Tsui Estate in Kwai Fong and the port, B11 between Tin Fu in Tin Shui Wai and the port, and overnight route NB73 between Sha Tin town centre and the port. KMB said the services will offer a two-ride, pay-one interchange concession with more than 100 KMB and Long Win routes.

Operations director Yeung Chun-wai said B10 passes the Tai Lam Tunnel interchange, where passengers can connect with more than 40 KMB or Long Win routes, and that the ride from that interchange to the port takes about 15 to 20 minutes. B11 runs via the San Tin public transport interchange and Yuen Long Main Road. NB73 is the overnight link, with connections at San Tin, Sha Tin and Sheung Shui.

On opening day, the first B10 and B11 departures are at 5:30am, the company said. The first NB73 from the port is at 11:30pm on Monday, and the first from Sha Tin town centre is at midnight. Staff will be at the termini to help passengers board.

zh.headline: 九巴下周一開辦三條新皇崗口岸路線
zh.dek: 葵芳、天水圍及沙田線隨口岸開通同日投入服務，並與逾百條路線提供搭兩程、俾一程優惠。
body: 九龍巴士周五表示，重建後的皇崗口岸下周一正式投入服務當天，將同步開辦三條往返口岸的專營巴士路線。
三條路線為B10（葵芳葵翠邨往返新皇崗口岸）、B11（天水圍天富往返新皇崗口岸），以及通宵線NB73（沙田市中心往返新皇崗口岸）。九巴指，新線會與逾百條九巴及龍運路線提供「搭兩程、俾一程」轉乘優惠。
車務總監楊晉瑋表示，B10經大欖隧道轉車站，乘客可在該站接駁逾40條九巴或龍運路線，由轉車站前往口岸約需15至20分鐘。B11經新田運輸交匯處及元朗大馬路；NB73則為深夜接駁，乘客可在新田、沙田或上水轉乘其他通宵線。
九巴表示，開通首日B10及B11首班車為上午5時30分。NB73由口岸開出的首班為周一晚上11時30分，由沙田市中心開出的首班則為周一午夜12時。各總站當天會派員協助乘客登車。
